theorem probe_nv_yes : ∃ I : GapCVP.Comparator.Instance,
    GapCVP.Comparator.hasIntegerTarget I = true ∧
    GapCVP.Comparator.gapYES400 I = true ∧
    GapCVP.Comparator.yesLanguage (GapCVP.Comparator.encodeInstance I) = true := by
  have hw : GapCVP.Comparator.wellFormed (⟨1, 1, fun _ => 0, 1⟩ : GapCVP.Comparator.Instance) = true := by
    unfold GapCVP.Comparator.wellFormed
    exact @decide_eq_true _ (Classical.propDecidable _) ⟨by simp, by simp, by simp⟩
  have h1 : GapCVP.Comparator.hasIntegerTarget (⟨1, 1, fun _ => 0, 1⟩ : GapCVP.Comparator.Instance) = true := by
    unfold GapCVP.Comparator.hasIntegerTarget
    exact @decide_eq_true _ (Classical.propDecidable _) (fun _ => ⟨0, by simp⟩)
  have h2 : GapCVP.Comparator.gapYES400 (⟨1, 1, fun _ => 0, 1⟩ : GapCVP.Comparator.Instance) = true := by
    unfold GapCVP.Comparator.gapYES400
    exact @decide_eq_true _ (Classical.propDecidable _)
      ⟨hw, fun _ => 0, by simp [GapCVP.Comparator.distanceSquared]⟩
  have h3 : GapCVP.Comparator.yesLanguage (GapCVP.Comparator.encodeInstance (⟨1, 1, fun _ => 0, 1⟩ : GapCVP.Comparator.Instance)) = true := by
    unfold GapCVP.Comparator.yesLanguage
    exact @decide_eq_true _ (Classical.propDecidable _) ⟨_, rfl, h1, h2⟩
  exact ⟨_, h1, h2, h3⟩
